# Fixture provenance (ADR-020)

Every fixture in this repository must be **synthetic** or derived from a **public OSS repository**, and must be listed here.

| Path | Source | Commit / version | License | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `crates/aaes-transcripts/src/*.rs` (inline test JSONL) | Synthetic, hand-written | — | MIT (this repo) | Mimics Claude Code / Codex transcript structure; no real session data |
| `tests/fixtures/search/*`, `tests/fixtures/read/*` | Synthetic, generated by `tests/fixtures/gen_golden.py` | — | MIT (this repo) | Golden fixtures for read/search fidelity (`crates/aaes-core/tests/golden.rs`); `*.expected` are reviewed snapshots |
| `bench/pilot/tasks/*.json` | Public OSS repositories: markedjs/marked, tj/commander.js, JoshClose/CsvHelper (MIT, MIT, MS-PL/Apache-2.0) | Commit ids listed per task | Per repository | M2 pilot tasks: repository URL, parent and fix commit ids, file lists, oracle command and the fix commit's subject as the bug report. No code is copied; runs clone the repositories. |

Private corpora (team repositories, real transcripts, raw tool output) live in the git-ignored `bench-private/` folder and must never be added here.
